verdict.rationale: CodeRabbit documents noise-reduction mechanisms (learning from chat feedback, path-based instructions, incremental vs full review commands, request-changes workflow, slop detection) but never explicitly documents 'severity labels' or comment deduplication. Community evidence is split: some praise clean, high-value catches (coderabbit-comm-1, comm-6, comm-7), but at least one concrete hands-on report says the tool was 'too verbose, catching too many false positives and never really added anything useful' leading to removal (coderabbit-comm-2), directly contradicting the low-noise claim. missing for 10: explicit severity-labeling feature, explicit deduplication mechanism, and consistent independent verification of low false-positive rates.
